Container.Name: Legato
Container.Overview: Legato is a local-first music player that lays your library out as a graph, with a wiki-style article for every recording, artist and album. This container is its server: it scans your music share read-only (FLAC, MP3, M4A, Ogg, WAV, APE), enriches it from keyless open sources such as MusicBrainz and Cover Art Archive, and serves the Legato desktop app and any browser on your network.[br][br] After the first start, open the WebUI. It shows a setup code (also printed in the container log) to create the owner account. Then add /music as a library folder.[br][br] Music is mounted read-only. Tag write-back, the one feature that edits files, needs the Music path switched to read/write, so take a backup first.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: music library flac musicbrainz streaming graph

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port for the web interface and for Legato apps to connect to. The container always listens on 8899 inside, so change only the host side if 8899 is taken.

Config.Name: Music
Config.Description: Your music share, for example /mnt/user/music. Mounted read-only. Inside Legato, add /music as the library folder.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database, cover art and waveform cache. Only legato.db* needs backing up; the rest rebuilds itself.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id the server runs as. 99 (nobody) owns Unraid's shares by default. Never 0: the container refuses to run as root.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id the server runs as. 100 (users) is Unraid's default.

Config.Name: Install channel
Config.Description: Tells Legato it was installed as a container, so update notices show the right steps. Leave as docker.
